description: Update a FreeAgent project task — rename it, change its billing rate or period, make it billable or not, or close it by setting status to 'Completed'. A task cannot move between projects. Only the fields you pass are changed.

billingPeriod.description: Whether the billing rate is per hour or per day

billingRate.description: Rate charged for time on this task

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the billing rate

isBillable.description: Whether time on this task is billable

name: freeagent_update_task
